facts.statement: SOE released its 33rd official podcast in April 2008; its description says Laralyn McWilliams visits the studio to talk about Free Realms.
facts.quote: meet Laralyn McWilliams, she pops into the studio to talk about Free Realms

article_summaries.title: Official SOE Podcast Hits Episode 33!
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post announcing SOE's Official SOE Podcast #33. Free Realms is one of several SOE titles listed, and the episode description says Laralyn McWilliams appears in the studio to talk about Free Realms. The post contains no game mechanics, quests, items or prices, so it is of little use beyond confirming an early 2008 podcast appearance.
